Formula 1 Announces Return to Africa with Rwanda Grand Prix

Formula 1 has confirmed its return to Africa, with Rwanda set to host a Grand Prix on a 10-year deal. The race is scheduled to begin in the early 2030s, marking Africa's first Grand Prix since 1993. The announcement signifies a significant expansion for the racing calendar.
